WEEKLY TIP -$1.9K/mo

Your Bulky SKUs Are Paying DIM Weight — Try Right-Sized Boxes

Across 174 of your shipments last month, billable weight exceeded actual weight by an average of 2.1 lb. The pattern points to oversized boxes on 14 specific SKUs.

What this means for you: Switching those 14 SKUs to dim-optimized cartons would cut about $1,920/month in dim overcharges. Start with SKU GH-4421 — biggest offender at $214/mo.
⚠ CRITICAL +$11.8K exposure

Section 301 List 4A Tariffs Raised to 27.5% on Small-Appliance HTS Codes

USTR confirmed the rate hike effective May 12, 2026. Three of your top 5 SKUs (HTS 8516.71, 8509.40) are on the affected list, including your espresso machine line.

What this means for you: Your landed cost on imports from China rises ~$3.40/unit. Pulling forward your Q3 PO before May 12 could save roughly $11,800 on the next inbound.
